Retrieval: Full WebFetch, 18 Jul 2026. AP wire, byline Jill Lawless, 17 Jul 2026 4:27 AM.

Andy Burnham declared leader of Britain's governing Labour Party Friday 17 July 2026. Secured nominations from 379 of 403 Labour MPs. UK's seventh PM since 2016. Starmer served two years before a forced resignation; he remains PM until Monday, when he tenders his resignation to King Charles III, who then asks Burnham to form a government.

Direct quotes (Andy Burnham, first speech as leader):
- "We're going to give them hope back." / "I have a plan."
- On devolution: "We will take power back from Westminster and Whitehall and give it to the place you live."
- On political reform: "I will work to build a new politics. The country is crying out for it."
- Vision: "hope in every heart" and "good growth in every post code."

Policy: transfer power from central government to local city/region leaders; social care access for ageing population; economic renewal and public-sector control; modern industrial job creation.
